moreInformation:
To be used as part of ensamble in production test 2026 (buildigns change detection). The training images have been transformed to align rooftops with building footprints. As a result, the model detects the position of rooftops rather than the actual positions of buildings. 

More info at : 
https://github.com/SDFIdk/ML_sdfi_fastai2/tree/SOTA_models_2026
